required_owner_deliverables.deliverable: A schema-valid closed-world seven-target algebra with exhaustive scientific-process and postpublication coordinates, licensed and forbidden operations, decision/probe typing and explicit supersession relation.
Signed recommendation, execution, adoption, promotion and merge boundaries plus complete unresolved, error, timeout, malformed and unsupported behavior.
Exact rights grant for storage, machine processing, derived semantic adjudication, audit quotation and the planned artifact release tier.
Content-addressed CONFORMANT or NONCONFORMANT review with no algebra authorship and no case/outcome custody.

non_substitution_rules: Public standards, metadata schemas, lexical similarity and repository authorship do not substitute for owner ratification or formal delegation.
The independent semantic reviewer cannot author or complete the algebra.
A public repository without applicable target-corpus rights cannot license the algebra by implication.
Missing fields remain CANNOT_CHECK and may not be filled by model inference.
unchanged_audit_rule: Only after every deliverable is bound may the existing 117,649-map audit be rerun without changing G1--G4, source terminals or target identifiers.
positive_condition: At least one map is fully certified after schema validation, rights validation, signatures and an independent CONFORMANT review.
negative_condition: All 117,649 maps are rejected after a completed lawful algebra and independent review; no target mapping is licensed under the unchanged constraints.
cannot_check_condition: Any role, delegation, field, right, signature, content hash or independent review is absent or unverifiable.
